title: dendrobium × graciliosum
intro: Dendrobium × graciliosum, commonly known as the Dendrobium Orchid, is a hybrid orchid species that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. This plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Dendrobium × graciliosum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. Studies have shown that Dendrobium × graciliosum may be used as a potential therapeutic agent for treating various diseases, including respiratory and cardiovascular disorders, due to its ability to modulate immune responses and reduce oxidative stress.
